claude.summary: ADB Extension for Command Palette is a Windows 11 PowerToys Command Palette extension exposing common adb operations for Android developers; it is on the Microsoft Store and WinGet, and has a companion blog post at costafotiadis.com. This covers the "ADB Quick Commands" idea noted on 10 Apr.
